## Summary

Michael Jackson's "Thriller" has climbed to No. 10 on the Billboard Hot 100 following the 2025 Halloween season, marking a significant milestone. This makes Jackson the first artist in history to score top 10 hits in six distinct decades, spanning the 1970s through the 2020s. 

The song jumped from No. 32 to No. 10 on the Billboard Hot 100 following Halloween. Jackson first reached the Hot 100 top 10 as a solo artist in November 1971 with "Got to Be There", and his most recent top 10 appearance prior to this week had been as a featured artist on Drake's "Don't Matter to Me" in 2018.
